'''Marjaak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. By [[44 ABY]], he had joined the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Tribe's armada]] as a crewmember of the ''[[Starstalker]]'', under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]]. Marjaak took part in the [[Violation|raid]] on the [[Fountain of Ancients]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], wherein he and fellow Sith Saber [[Anyul]] took samples of [[wintrium]] from the Fountain. They were attacked by [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards and then by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and apprehended. Holpur and his entire crew, including Marjaak, were later sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] for violating the Fountain.
